description: This file defines a class 'default_formatter' which provides methods for formatting data in the context of SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM connectors, including fetching templates and source mappings.

classes.name: default_formatter
classes.description: A generic formatter class for SuiteCRM connector integrations, handling template fetching and source mapping.

methods.name: getDetailViewFormat
methods.description: Generates the detail view format by selecting appropriate templates based on source class and module.

methods.name: getEditViewFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for edit view formatting.

methods.name: getListViewFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for list view formatting.

methods.name: getSearchFormFormat
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for search form formatting.

methods.name: fetchSmarty
methods.description: Fetches the Smarty template based on source class and module, with fallback options.

methods.name: getSourceMapping
methods.description: Returns the source mapping from the component's source.

methods.name: setSmarty
methods.description: Sets the Smarty template engine instance.

methods.name: getSmarty
methods.description: Returns the current Smarty template engine instance.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Sets the component associated with this formatter.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the component associated with this formatter.

methods.name: getIconFilePath
methods.description: Returns an empty string, placeholder for icon file path.
